name: Suprajit Engineering Ltd
tagline: Global auto-cables/mechatronics/electronics maker in a genuine margin-recovery inflection -- GCM restructuring delivered (EBIT 5.8%->12.6%) and SED compounding 48% -- but consolidated PAT rose only 9% in Q1 FY27 as Rs 993 Cr of debt eats the operating leverage; mid-teens ROE and a full 37x multiple make a literal 10x implausible

fundamentals_narrative: A genuine operating inflection: the loss-making Global Cables & Mechatronics (GCM) division completed its restructuring and swung to a 12.6% EBIT margin in Q1 FY27 (from 5.8%), with management confirming 'no material one-offs' and ~20-23% organic growth; SED (sensors/electronics/displays) grew revenue 48% and EBITDA 100% and is expanding capacity 'on a war footing'. Consolidated Q1 FY27 revenue rose 24% and EBITDA 57.5%. But the deep read tempers the enthusiasm at the bottom line: consolidated PAT rose only 9% YoY -- interest and depreciation on Rs 993 Cr of (rising) borrowings absorb most of the EBITDA gain -- and returns are still mid-teens (ROCE ~15.5%, ROE ~13.1%). The Q3 FY26 quarter (EPS Rs 0.91 vs Rs 3.71 the prior quarter) shows how lumpy earnings remain through the restructuring period. At ~37x trailing / ~16x EV-EBITDA the multiple already discounts a clean FY27; the edge is only if GCM holds the top of its 10-12% guide and SED keeps compounding beyond consensus.

verdict_headline: A real, clean margin-recovery inflection (GCM restructuring delivered, SED compounding) in a well-governed global auto-ancillary -- but Rs 993 Cr of rising debt caps the EPS benefit (PAT +9% on EBITDA +57.5%), returns are mid-teens, and the size math rules out a literal 10x; conviction cut to Medium-High, thesis reclassified to 'neither'
verdict_reasoning: Thesis-fit moved 10x-in-2-3-years -> neither: at ~Rs 7,000 Cr mcap and ~13% ROE, a 10x in 2-3 years would imply a ~Rs 70,000 Cr auto-cables/electronics supplier -- not a credible path. The GCM 5.8%->12.6% recovery plus the SED engine is a quality-compounder / possible-double-over-3-4-years story if execution stays clean, not a moonshot. This is a bucket reclassification, not a negative verdict on the business

Conviction lowered High -> Medium-High: consolidated Q1 FY27 PAT grew only 9% YoY despite EBITDA +57.5% (leverage on Rs 993 Cr debt), consolidated ROCE/ROE are mid-teens, earnings remain lumpy (Q3 FY26 EPS Rs 0.91), ICM margin dipped 15%->13%, and ~37x trailing is a full multiple. Held at Medium-High -- not lower -- by a genuinely delivered, clean GCM turnaround, a compounding SED order book, clean governance, and a large sustained trusted position

No red flags; the 2024 buyback-pricing debate was resolved as a tax-efficient dividend alternative. Watch: H2 FY27 for GCM EBITDA margin sustained near/above 12% (not one quarter), consolidated margin in the 12-13.5% band, SED capacity online, and ICM margin recovering toward 15%

deep_dive.conviction_update: High -> Medium-High, and thesis-fit 10x-in-2-3-years -> neither. The GCM turnaround and SED engine are real and clean, but consolidated PAT rose only 9% in Q1 FY27 (leverage), returns are mid-teens, earnings are lumpy, and a ~Rs 7,000 Cr mid-cap at ~13% ROE cannot credibly 10x in 2-3 years. Downgrade reflects the bottom-line reality and the bucket, not a governance or quality concern.
